Subject: Vendor enrollment: linking invoices to POs and EFT setup

Hi Ben,

We're getting Redwood set up in Acme's vendor system and have two immediate asks so AP can process your first invoice:

1) EFT mandate / bank details: please complete and return our EFT mandate (I attached the template). We need a signed mandate and a voided check or bank verification document to create the vendor record.

2) PO linkage on invoices: When you submit invoices, please make sure each invoice includes the Acme PO number in the invoice header and also in a discrete invoice field named "CustomerPO" (our upload system maps that field to the PO for automated matching). We also require the PO line item numbers when billing against individual lines.

Other info we need: vendor remit address, tax ID/EIN (or VAT ID for EU entities), and the remit contact email for billing notifications. Preferred invoice formats are PDF or UBL (cXML/UBL acceptable).

Can you confirm who will be the vendor contact on your side and attach a sample invoice so we can validate mapping?

Thanks,
Maria Santos
Senior AP Operations Manager
Acme Retail

Attaching the signed EFT mandate (eft-mandate-form-signed.pdf) and an example invoice (redwood-invoice-20261128.pdf) for your team to validate. A few notes and confirmations from finance: 

- Bank verification: we included a bank letter and ACH setup page in the EFT mandate. Our bank usually completes verification within 48 business hours once the mandate and voided check are uploaded to the vendor portal.
- Tax: Redwood US EIN is 94-1234567. No VAT registration is associated with the US legal entity; if Acme needs a VAT-registered entity for EU billing, reply and we will provide the EU entity details.
- Invoice fields: we will populate the following fields on each invoice by default: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, TotalAmount, CustomerPO (Acme PO number), PO_LineNumber (where applicable), RemitTo (address), RemitEmail (finance-ops@redwood.ai). Payment terms: Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated.
- Remittance email: please ensure your portal routes invoice acceptance notifications to finance-ops@redwood.ai; we monitor that address for AP replies and payment confirmations.

If Acme requires additional compliance docs (SOC 2 report, certs), we can provide the standard redacted SOC 2 and security attestation materials through your secure upload link.

Ben, please let me know if you want me to start a DocuSign envelope for W-9 or if Maria prefers to collect that directly in the portal.
